purpose: Gap-narrowing Book enrichment focused on quantified black-speck/black-dot intervention outcomes, cycle-resolved hot-runner cleaning recovery, injection-mould predictive-maintenance decisions, and hot-runner actual-state observability. Exact DOI/title searches were screened against main and the current PR patch before admission.

candidates.title: Quality Improvement of Black Spot Defects in the Plastic Injection Molding Process at Company ABC
data: black-spot defect share 7.85% before intervention
overall Process Z 1.42 before intervention
Why-Why analysis identifying filter-mesh design as the study root cause
filter-mesh design improvement
black-spot defect share 2.16% after implementation
overall Process Z 2.02 after implementation
work instruction and control plan for sustainment
candidates.rightsState: public IEOM conference paper/PDF; reuse licence was not established in this pass, so retain as evidence/reference, quote minimally, and create original Book tables/graphics
candidates.value: Adds a quantified plant black-spot defect -> identified intervention -> post-implementation outcome chain rather than another generic defect-cause list.
candidates.limitations: Single-company applied case; the published summary is not a shot-by-shot time series and the filter-mesh conclusion is case-specific rather than a universal black-speck cause.

candidates.title: Black dot defect reduction in plastic injection moulding process
candidates.scale: two injection-moulding machines, P24 and P25
data: black-dot defect proportion 0.65% before improvement
Gage R&R plus cause/effect, FMEA, Why-Why and hypothesis-testing workflow
four statistically tested factors: dirty/carbonised barrel and screw, previous material trapped in barrel, raw-material degradation, and hopper contamination
DOE and confirmation testing before production implementation
black-dot defect proportion 0.34% after improvement
reported 47.69% reduction
work instruction, control plan and control charts for sustainment
candidates.rightsState: Chulalongkorn University ETD record is licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0; use factual findings and Book-owned explanations, and do not adapt/reproduce protected thesis figures or tables by default
candidates.value: Provides an independent structured black-dot intervention case with measurement-system checking, hypothesis testing, DOE, confirmation and a quantified production outcome.
candidates.limitations: Master's thesis rather than peer-reviewed journal evidence; no public shot-order onset/recovery trace is established, and the identified factors remain plant/machine/material specific.

candidates.title: Developing a method for evaluating color changeover in a hot-runner multi-cavity injection mold
candidates.scale: two-cavity valve-gated hot-runner mould; ABS; individual samples recorded by cycle and cavity
data: digital image recorded for every sampled part with cavity and cycle identity
combined injection-unit plus hot-runner cleaning visually completed at approximately 135 cycles
separate hot-runner test after injection-unit cleaning ran for 105 cycles
modelled cycles to 99% clean: 148 and 132 for the two nozzles in combined cleaning versus 34 and 34 in separate cleaning
cleaning material 6.3 kg combined versus 3.2 kg separate
reported time and material consumption about 50% lower when injection unit and hot runner were cleaned independently
saturation-curve model described measured color-change data with 97.8% accuracy
candidates.rightsState: open-access CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 article; use factual measurements and create original Book plots/tables without adapting protected figures unless the intended reuse is separately permitted
candidates.value: Rare cycle-by-cycle, cavity-identified visual cleaning trajectory in a hot-runner mould. It supplies the chronology structure the Book needs for recovery teaching even though the observed defect is color carryover rather than black specks.
candidates.limitations: This is color-changeover/cleaning evidence, not a black-speck onset dataset; it must never be presented as closing the black-speck raw-trace gap.

candidates.title: Predictive maintenance on injection molds by generalized fault trees and anomaly detection
data: industrial application at OLI, an injection-moulded plastic-parts producer
generalized fault-tree reliability assessment
isolation-forest anomaly detection
training objective minimizing operational costs
reported potential savings 27.05% versus optimized fixed-period preventive maintenance
reported potential savings 63.43% versus corrective maintenance
candidates.rightsState: open-access Procedia Computer Science article under a Creative Commons licence; use source-backed factual findings and Book-owned maintenance-decision graphics
candidates.value: Adds a real injection-mould industrial maintenance-decision case, complementing Wave 6's natural lifecycle/metrology evidence with an explicit intervention-scheduling/cost framework.
candidates.limitations: The savings are study/model outputs, not universal maintenance economics; this source does not provide the desired public wear -> maintenance action -> post-maintenance recovery raw history. The 2023 Applied Sciences paper is an extended version of this work and is not independent evidence.

candidates.title: Development of a cavity pressure control for injection moulding by adjusting the cross-section in the hot runner
data: commercial servo-electrically driven hot-runner valve pin
one-cavity mould with two cavity-pressure sensors
opening stroke varied to change hot-runner pressure resistance and cavity pressure transfer
PID controller compares actual cavity pressure with a reference curve and compensates using pin movement
provoked holding-pressure disturbances could be compensated
material-behaviour changes such as mould-temperature fluctuations could not be compensated by the reference-control approach
candidates.rightsState: journal article; figure/data republication rights were not established in this pass, so use as evidence/reference and create original explanatory diagrams
candidates.value: Adds peer-reviewed experimental detail to the Wave 5 IKV valve-pin-control family and makes the distinction between measured cavity pressure, actual pin movement and control limitations explicit.
candidates.limitations: Same broader IKV research family as Wave 5 sources, so it is not counted as an independent experimental family. It still does not expose raw motor-current traces or cavity-specific part-quality traces.

candidates.title: New solutions for valve gate technology and networked injection moulding
data: linear servo motors with permanent high-precision valve-pin position control
motor current consumption controlled as a function of required force at constant speed and usable to monitor valve-pin closing force
process-data export via OPC UA
documented 4+4-cavity Luer-connector demonstration cell
two cavity-pressure sensors per cavity recorded in the demonstration cell
current EWIKON technical documentation also states torque/current consumption can indicate system condition and valve-pin position is continuously monitored
candidates.rightsState: manufacturer/trade technical material; capability descriptions may be cited factually but do not reuse vendor graphics by default
candidates.value: Directly identifies the signal architecture needed for the remaining hot-runner evidence gap: pin position, motor current/force, cavity pressure and networked monitoring can coexist in one production cell.
candidates.limitations: Vendor/trade capability evidence is not a public synchronized raw trace and does not demonstrate a causal link from current/position to cavity-specific part quality; the raw actual-state + quality gap therefore remains open.
